features: 30000mAh Battery Capacity: Power through your day and beyond with the boAt EnergyShroom PB665 Turbo X, featuring a massive 30000mAh battery. Built with lithium-ion polymer cells known to deliver stable performance over extended periods, it is perfect for heavy users, travellers, and multi-device charging.

4 Output Ports and 2 Input Ports: Charge up to 4 devices simultaneously with 2x USB-A and 2x Type-C (2-way) ports all supporting turbo fast charging speed. Plus, it features, 2x Type-C (2-Way) input ports that let you recharge the power bank itself quickly, ensuring minimal downtime between uses.
65W Turbo Fast Charging: The turbo fast 65W charging fuels your devices in minutes. It ensures stable, high-speed charging experience without reducing the overall speed.

Pass-Through Charging: PB665 features pass-through charging that lets you charge the power bank while it is also charges your devices. You can plug in the power bank to charge and at the same time connect your phone to it, both will charge together.

12 Layer Smart IC Protection: The power bank supports 12 layers of protection through a built-in IC (integrated circuit). It helps prevent overcharging, overheating, short circuits, and excessive current, ensuring worry-free charging every time.
